topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Aye, it's a hard truth to swallow, that my friend will be tilling fields far from here. But I tell you, I’ve always known the day would come. Our valleys are small, and the world is wide. I gave him advice on the best seeds to take, the hardy ones that will withstand any soil. I reckon he’ll do well; his hands have always been as skilled as mine. And I’ve told him, if ever he forgets the scent of the damp earth or the rustle of the wind through the wheat, to think on this place and this friendship. I’ve no doubt he’ll thrive, and I’ll be here, where I belong, proud of the land and the life we’ve both chosen.
